messages:
Alex: Heads-up: linux-gpu-e2e is red on main. Heap assert in allocator during kv-cache tests. Link: <ci/job/12345>. Can someone bisect? @Jamal @Priya
CI-bot: CI job failed: linux-gpu-e2e — job 12345 — exit code 139. Log excerpt:
```[allocator] ASSERT failed: free_block->size >= requested
  at redis_allocator.cc:213
  stack: allocate() -> slab_alloc() -> free_block_check()
...
```
Priya: What's the last green on main?
Alex: last green: 3a1f7b2 (build 1795399999). I ran a quick `git log` around merges; suspect: deps/llvm upgrade MR #4329 merged yesterday. Not certain.
Jamal: I'll take bisect. Do we have a quick repro command?
Alex: Run `./tools/test_ci.sh linux-gpu-e2e --filter kv_cache` or repro with `bazel test //tests/allocator:kv_cache_test --runs_per_test=10` — failure pops ~1/10. Use `git bisect` starting at last green / HEAD.
Casey: If it's flaky try `git bisect run ./ci/bisect-runner.sh` — runner reruns test a few times to filter flakes.
Jamal: Starting bisect now. Will post suspected commit. ETA ~30m.
Jamal: Bisect narrowed to commit 7d9b4c5 — touchpoints: bump llvm -> 13.2. Seems consistent locally after ~50 runs. Probable culprit.
Priya: Can you open revert PR? We should triage upstream llvm but unblock CI.
Jamal: Opened revert: https://git/repo/pull/4351 — CI queued.
CI-bot: Revert PR 4351 passed linux-gpu-e2e on CI. All green. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Nice — confirming main is green. Thanks @Jamal and @Casey. Let's add a regression test that pins allocator behavior.
Priya: Filed follow-up issue to investigate llvm bump interactions: #1122. Assigning to eng-ml.
